snippet.title: Zero Hour Reforged | C&C Generals Zero Hour rebuilt from its source | Trailer
snippet.description:
Zero Hour Reforged is Command & Conquer Generals Zero Hour built from the source code EA released, running on current Windows in 64-bit. Free download at https://zerohour.gg. You need your own copy of Zero Hour from Steam or the EA app.

Everything in this trailer was recorded in the game itself.

0:00 Then and now
0:13 The look
0:32 Units that move like machines
0:56 Command and control
1:08 A smarter opponent, big battles, LAN and replays

What you see in it:
- A Direct3D 11 renderer with the frame rate uncapped
- Smoke that casts real shadows, and fire that lights its own smoke
- 481 base-game textures at four times the resolution
- Trees whose shadow is the tree, water that reflects what stands over it
- Tanks and cars that accelerate, brake and reverse, turrets that fire on the move
- Helicopters that fly backwards and sideways with the nose on the target
- Groups that spread out across bridges, soldiers that step round tanks
- Flares and hard-kill charges against missiles
- One key per command grid button, queued orders drawn on the ground, and the ground your defences cannot shoot shaded
- A computer opponent with three difficulty levels, none of which cheat
- 840 units on one click
- House rules set by the LAN host, a broadcast-style observer camera, and replays you can jump around in
- Around 60 of the original game's bugs found and fixed

Source code (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/olcayseygan/CnCGeneralsZH-Reforged

Music from the Command & Conquer Generals soundtrack, (c) Electronic Arts.
Zero Hour Reforged is a community project, not made or endorsed by Electronic Arts. Command & Conquer and Zero Hour are trademarks of Electronic Arts.
